reviews.title: Excellent charger
reviews.comment: This charger works great. I have a Galaxy S24 Ultra and the charger supports super fast charging 2.0 and standard fast charging. Would definitely purchase again.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.comment: Works great!! The Rgb is a pretty nice touch and you can switch the colors. I bought this since my pc had a 600W one. This was easy to install all the cables were neatly packaged and both the ports and cables where labeled so you know which one goes where. It’s pretty quiet so you won’t hear it when gaming.
